title: Review Loop Config
description: Protected Review Loop policy. Do not place this file in a candidate PR and expect it to control that PR: load it from a harness path outside the candidate worktree with --config, or from a declared base revision with --base and --base-config.

dastTargets.description: Protected targets only. Running probes additionally requires --authorize-external-probes and one matching --allow-external-target origin in the current invocation. URLs with userinfo, query strings, or fragments are rejected.
